This build of the app has no tag firmware in it. Update from a computer instead.
The tag already runs this version. You can install it again if something seems wrong.
The tag runs a newer version than the one in this app. Installing it would go back to an older version.

It takes about a minute. Keep the cable plugged in and the screen on. Android asks for USB access twice: once for the tag in update mode, which counts as a different device, and once when the tag restarts. Pairing, keys, zones and settings stay on the tag.
